chunks: And Zurārah narrated from him that he said:

key_terms.اَلصَّلَوَاتِ: the prayers, referring to the prescribed salat (prayer)
key_terms.اَلْقُنُوتُ: qunoot, the supplication recited in prayer
key_terms.زُرَارَةُ: Zurārah, the narrator transmitting this report

ai.seo_question: Is qunoot performed in all prayers according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that qunoot is prescribed in all prayers. It indicates a general legal ruling concerning the place of supplication within salat (prayer) in Shia practice.
